name: ExertPro Product Publish Reminder
author: ExertPro

sections.description:
ExertPro Product Publish Reminder helps store owners avoid publishing incomplete products by validating essential product information before publishing or updating. Instead of blocking the process, it displays a clear warning popup listing missing information and lets the user decide whether to go back and fix the product or publish anyway.

The plugin never permanently blocks publishing. It only warns.

Free features

  • Validates: Featured Image, Gallery Images, Product Category, Price, SKU, Description, Short Description, Stock Status
  • Clean warning popup with “Go Back” and “Publish Anyway”
  • Runs on both new products and updates
  • Settings page under WooCommerce → ExertPro Product Publish Reminder to enable/disable each check
  • Dismissible dashboard notice showing how many products are incomplete
  • Product list filters: Missing Image, SKU, Category, Description, Price
  • No external API calls, lightweight, translation-ready

Planned Pro features (not included in this version)

Product Quality Score, Bulk Product Scanner, Category-based Validation Rules, Brand Validation, Minimum Gallery Images, Minimum Description Length, Required Product Tags/Attributes/Custom Fields, SEO Validation (Rank Math & Yoast), Image Alt Text Validation, Shipping Validation, Downloadable Product Validation, Product Type-specific Rules, Weekly Email Reports, Validation Profiles, White Label, Developer API, Priority Support.

See WooCommerce → ExertPro Product Publish Reminder Pro inside the plugin for the full comparison table.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the exertpro-product-publish-reminder folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to WooCommerce → ExertPro Product Publish Reminder to choose which fields are required.
sections.faq:
Does this block me from publishing a product?

No. It only shows a warning. You can always click “Publish Anyway”.

Does this call any external API?

No. All validation happens locally using data already in your WordPress database.

Does it slow down my site?

No. Scripts and styles only load on the relevant wp-admin screens (product edit and product list) and nothing loads on the front end.
